module_summary: MUX-based clock-domain-crossing synchronizer: data and enable are registered in clk_a, the enable passes a two-flop synchronizer in clk_b, and the synchronized enable selects data_reg into dataout.

anchors.name: data_reg
anchors.why: clk_a-domain register holding data_in, sampled across domain into dataout

anchors.name: en_data_reg
anchors.why: clk_a-domain registered data_en fed into the clk_b synchronizer

anchors.name: en_clap_one
anchors.why: First clk_b synchronizer flop for the enable

anchors.name: en_clap_two
anchors.why: Synchronized enable selecting data_reg versus held dataout

anchors.name: dataout
anchors.why: clk_b-domain output updated from data_reg when enable synchronized

anchors.name: data_in
anchors.why: Source-domain data input captured into data_reg

anchors.name: data_en
anchors.why: Source-domain data-valid enable to be synchronized

groups.name: Source domain capture
groups.description: clk_a registers capturing data and enable

groups.name: Enable synchronizer
groups.description: Two-flop clk_b synchronizer for the data enable

groups.name: Output mux register
groups.description: clk_b output register loading data_reg on synchronized enable
